facts.text: Serve dessert when the Nicelanders hand Felix a pie at the anniversary party.
facts.why: At the anniversary party it is a cake the Nicelanders bring out, which Ralph smashes. Pie is only what Ralph says Felix gets thanked with.
facts.fix: Serve dessert when the Nicelanders bring out the cake at the anniversary party.

facts.text: Pie so good it ought to be a crime. Est. 1973.
facts.why: Tapper is the bar in the film and the Tapper game dates from 1983, while Fix-It Felix Jr. turns 30 in the film. 1973 matches neither. The line comes from the shared diner layout, not data.
facts.fix: Pie so good it ought to be a crime. Est. 1983.

vibe.verdict: Tapper's is a clever venue, but the cue and the pie angle rest on a party scene the film does not show that way.
